text: The **University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD) Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13)** dataset shows that there was forest on the property in 2020. While the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) did not confirm forest presence, the Hansen dataset recorded tree-cover loss events in 2020, implying that forest was present at the start of that year. The observation tool explicitly notes "tree cover in 2000 (≥30% canopy)" and records loss events in 2020, confirming prior forest presence.
